card.name: Linking words after cardiac arrest
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas right after a mention of cardiac arrest, asystole or resuscitation, just before the text says what resuscitation measures follow.

modes.label: Comma after 'should occur'
modes.description: The comma that closes an 'If cardiac arrest should occur' clause, before the resuscitation instructions.
modes.example: If cardiac arrest should occur<<,>> standard cardiopulmonary resuscitative

modes.label: Link word in asystole advice
modes.description: A preposition or 'including' in the sentence about handling asystole with the usual measures.
modes.example: Asystole should be handled by the usual measures<< including>> cardiopulmonary resuscitation.

card.writes: It pushes the model away from the word 'values' and toward other continuations, with no clear positive theme.
card.plain: It fires on the small connecting word or comma right after cardiac arrest is mentioned, as the label moves on to resuscitation.
